title: lastrea levingei
intro: Lastrea levingei, commonly known as the L. levingei fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of L. levingei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may aid in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of L. levingei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
